title: Watashi wa ~ desu
description: Self-introductions, basic sentence structure (X wa Y desu), occupations, nationalities, and courtesy greetings.
description_en: Self-introductions, basic sentence structure (X wa Y desu), occupations, nationalities, and courtesy greetings.
description_id: Perkenalan diri, struktur kalimat dasar (X wa Y desu), profesi, kewarganegaraan, dan salam sopan santun.

title: Kore wa ~ desu
description: Demonstrative pronouns (kore/sore/are), demonstrative determiners (kono/sono/ano), asking what things are, and numbers.
description_en: Demonstrative pronouns (kore/sore/are), demonstrative determiners (kono/sono/ano), asking what things are, and numbers.
description_id: Kata ganti penunjuk (kore/sore/are), penentu penunjuk (kono/sono/ano), menanyakan benda, dan angka.

title: Koko wa ~ desu
description: Locations (koko/soko/asoko/doko), rooms, facilities, stores, prices, and demonstratives of direction.
description_en: Locations (koko/soko/asoko/doko), rooms, facilities, stores, prices, and demonstratives of direction.
description_id: Lokasi (koko/soko/asoko/doko), ruangan, fasilitas, toko, harga, dan penunjuk arah.

title: Nanji desu ka
description: Telling time, daily routine verbs, days of the week, particle ni for specific time, and kara/made for duration.
description_en: Telling time, daily routine verbs, days of the week, particle ni for specific time, and kara/made for duration.
description_id: Menyatakan waktu, kata kerja rutinitas harian, nama hari, partikel ni untuk waktu spesifik, dan kara/made untuk durasi.

title: ~ e ikimasu
description: Verbs of motion (iku/kuru/kaeru), destination particle (e/ni), means of transportation (de), calendar dates, and holidays.
description_en: Verbs of motion (iku/kuru/kaeru), destination particle (e/ni), means of transportation (de), calendar dates, and holidays.
description_id: Kata kerja perpindahan (iku/kuru/kaeru), partikel tujuan (e/ni), sarana transportasi (de), tanggal, dan hari libur.

title: ~ o tabemasu
description: Transitive actions with object particle wo, action locations with de, invitations with masenka, and proposals with mashou.
description_en: Transitive actions with object particle wo, action locations with de, invitations with masenka, and proposals with mashou.
description_id: Kata kerja transitif dengan partikel objek wo, lokasi aktivitas dengan de, ajakan dengan masenka, dan tawaran dengan mashou.

title: Dougu de ~ shimasu
description: Tools and methods with de, giving/receiving (ageru/morau/kureru), greetings for visiting, and already (mou) vs yet (mada).
description_en: Tools and methods with de, giving/receiving (ageru/morau/kureru), greetings for visiting, and already (mou) vs yet (mada).
description_id: Alat dan metode dengan de, memberi/menerima (ageru/morau/kureru), salam berkunjung, dan sudah (mou) vs belum (mada).

title: Kirei desu
description: Adjectives (I-adjectives and Na-adjectives), noun modification, degrees (totemo/amari), and contrasts with ga.
description_en: Adjectives (I-adjectives and Na-adjectives), noun modification, degrees (totemo/amari), and contrasts with ga.
description_id: Kata sifat (Akhiran-i dan Akhiran-na), modifikasi kata benda, tingkatan (totemo/amari), dan kontras dengan ga.

title: ~ ga suki desu
description: Expressing preferences (suki/kirai), abilities (jouzu/heta), comprehension (wakaru), possession (aru), and reasons (kara/dakara).
description_en: Expressing preferences (suki/kirai), abilities (jouzu/heta), comprehension (wakaru), possession (aru), and reasons (kara/dakara).
description_id: Menyatakan kesukaan (suki/kirai), kemampuan (jouzu/heta), pemahaman (wakaru), kepemilikan (aru), dan alasan (kara/dakara).

title: ~ ni ~ ga arimasu
description: Existence of animate and inanimate entities (arimasu/imasu), locations (ni), spatial prepositions, and lists (ya/nado).
description_en: Existence of animate and inanimate entities (arimasu/imasu), locations (ni), spatial prepositions, and lists (ya/nado).
description_id: Keberadaan makhluk hidup dan benda mati (arimasu/imasu), lokasi (ni), preposisi ruang, dan daftar (ya/nado).

title: Hitotsu kudasai
description: Counters, counting general objects, people, thin objects, machinery, frequency, time spans, and dake.
description_en: Counters, counting general objects, people, thin objects, machinery, frequency, time spans, and dake.
description_id: Kata bantu bilangan, menghitung benda umum, orang, benda tipis, mesin, frekuensi, rentang waktu, dan dake.

title: ~ wa ~ yori ~ desu
description: Comparative and superlative forms (yori, hou ga, ichiban, dochira), past tense of adjectives, and weather terms.
description_en: Comparative and superlative forms (yori, hou ga, ichiban, dochira), past tense of adjectives, and weather terms.
description_id: Bentuk komparatif dan superlatif (yori, hou ga, ichiban, dochira), bentuk lampau kata sifat, dan istilah cuaca.

title: ~ ga hoshii desu
description: Expressing desires with hoshii and tai, purpose of movement with ni iku/kuru, and entering/leaving particles.
description_en: Expressing desires with hoshii and tai, purpose of movement with ni iku/kuru, and entering/leaving particles.
description_id: Menyatakan keinginan dengan hoshii dan tai, tujuan pergerakan dengan ni iku/kuru, dan partikel masuk/keluar.

title: Te-kudasai
description: Verb te-form, making requests with te kudasai, progressive actions with te imasu, and offering help with mashou ka.
description_en: Verb te-form, making requests with te kudasai, progressive actions with te imasu, and offering help with mashou ka.
description_id: Kata kerja bentuk-te, meminta bantuan dengan te kudasai, aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung dengan te imasu, dan menawarkan bantuan dengan mashou ka.

title: ~ te mo ii desu
description: Granting permission (te mo ii), stating prohibition (te wa ikemasen), continuous states, and profession/residence states.
description_en: Granting permission (te mo ii), stating prohibition (te wa ikemasen), continuous states, and profession/residence states.
description_id: Memberikan izin (te mo ii), menyatakan larangan (te wa ikemasen), kondisi berkelanjutan, dan status profesi/tempat tinggal.

title: ~ te, ~ te, ~ masu
description: Connecting successive verbs and adjectives with te-form, te kara for chronological sequence, and adverbial forms (ku/ni).
description_en: Connecting successive verbs and adjectives with te-form, te kara for chronological sequence, and adverbial forms (ku/ni).
description_id: Menyambung kata kerja dan kata sifat berturut-turut dengan bentuk-te, te kara untuk urutan kronologis, dan bentuk adverbia (ku/ni).

title: ~ nai de kudasai
description: Verb nai-form, negative requests (naide kudasai), obligations (nakereba narimasen), and exemptions (nakutemo ii desu).
description_en: Verb nai-form, negative requests (naide kudasai), obligations (nakereba narimasen), and exemptions (nakutemo ii desu).
description_id: Kata kerja bentuk-nai, larangan/jangan (naide kudasai), kewajiban (nakereba narimasen), dan pengecualian (nakutemo ii desu).

title: ~ koto ga dekimasu
description: Dictionary form, expressing capability with koto ga dekimasu, stating hobbies (shumi wa ~ koto), and temporal priority with mae ni.
description_en: Dictionary form, expressing capability with koto ga dekimasu, stating hobbies (shumi wa ~ koto), and temporal priority with mae ni.
description_id: Bentuk kamus, menyatakan kemampuan dengan koto ga dekimasu, hobi (shumi wa ~ koto), dan prioritas waktu dengan mae ni.

title: ~ ta koto ga arimasu
description: Ta-form of verbs, recounting past experiences (ta koto ga aru), non-exhaustive listing (tari..tari suru), and state changes (narimasu).
description_en: Ta-form of verbs, recounting past experiences (ta koto ga aru), non-exhaustive listing (tari..tari suru), and state changes (narimasu).
description_id: Kata kerja bentuk-ta, menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu (ta koto ga aru), daftar aktivitas tidak spesifik (tari..tari suru), dan perubahan keadaan (narimasu).

title: Futsuu-kei (Plain Form)
description: Informal/plain speech styles for verbs, adjectives, and nouns in casual conversations among family and friends.
description_en: Informal/plain speech styles for verbs, adjectives, and nouns in casual conversations among family and friends.
description_id: Gaya bicara kasual/informal untuk kata kerja, kata sifat, dan kata benda dalam percakapan santai dengan keluarga dan teman.

title: ~ to omoimasu
description: Expressing conjecture/opinion with to omoimasu, direct and indirect speech quotes with to iimasu, and intention with tsumori.
description_en: Expressing conjecture/opinion with to omoimasu, direct and indirect speech quotes with to iimasu, and intention with tsumori.
description_id: Menyatakan dugaan/pendapat dengan to omoimasu, kutipan langsung dan tidak langsung dengan to iimasu, dan niat dengan tsumori.

title: ~ no wa ~ desu
description: Noun modification clauses (relative clauses), clothing/wear verbs (kiru/haku/kaburu/kakeru), and complex descriptors.
description_en: Noun modification clauses (relative clauses), clothing/wear verbs (kiru/haku/kaburu/kakeru), and complex descriptors.
description_id: Klausa modifikasi kata benda (relative clauses), kata kerja memakai pakaian (kiru/haku/kaburu/kakeru), dan deskriptor kompleks.

title: ~ toki, ~ masu
description: Temporal clauses with toki, natural condition/result with to, and road navigation/directions.
description_en: Temporal clauses with toki, natural condition/result with to, and road navigation/directions.
description_id: Klausa waktu dengan toki, kondisi/hasil alami dengan to, dan navigasi/petunjuk jalan.

title: Te-moraimasu / Te-agemasu
description: Benefactive auxiliary verbs (te ageru / te morau / te kureru), simultaneous actions with nagara, and after with ato de.
description_en: Benefactive auxiliary verbs (te ageru / te morau / te kureru), simultaneous actions with nagara, and after with ato de.
description_id: Kata kerja bantu penerimaan/pemberian (te ageru / te morau / te kureru), aktivitas bersamaan dengan nagara, dan setelah dengan ato de.

title: ~ tara, ~ masu
description: Conditionals with tara (if/when), hypothetical concession with temo (even if), and negative totality with mo.
description_en: Conditionals with tara (if/when), hypothetical concession with temo (even if), and negative totality with mo.
description_id: Pengandaian dengan tara (jika/kalau), konsesi hipotetis dengan temo (meskipun), dan totalitas negatif dengan mo.
